messages:
nina_support: Vendora reported autopay failed for invoice INV-9876 twice. They say card charges fine elsewhere. Gateway responses: authentication_required -> then final card_declined. Can payments team triage?

maria_billing: FYI invoice has po_required: true and VAT id on file (VAT: GB999888777). customer says their finance dept requires PO on the invoice before paying. Not sure if our autopay flow attaches PO metadata to the payment attempt.

raj_payments: Can you paste the raw charge/attempt logs? Need gateway payload + merchant metadata. Also what flow did autopay use (server-side charge vs hosted pay link)?

nina_support: Pasting redacted attempt log below (token and names scrubbed).
```json
{"invoice_id":"INV-9876","attempt_id":"att_01Hxyz","payment_method_token":"pm_tok_***","po_required":true,"attempt_type":"autopay","gateway_response":{"status":"requires_action","reason":"authentication_required","next_action":{"type":"redirect_to_url","url":"https://acs.acquirer.example/challenge?session=abc123"}}}
```

repro-bot: automated repro run (2025-08-14T14:02Z): ran charge using stored token -> gateway returned 302 -> browser redirect attempted inside iframe -> blocked. Response: 200 with body containing ACS iframe markup but console shows third-party cookie blocked. Repro output: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/invoices/INV-9876/pay \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -d '{"payment_method":"pm_tok_***","auto_confirm":true}'

# response
{"status":"requires_action","next_action":{"type":"redirect_to_url","url":"https://acs.acquirer.example/challenge?session=abc123"}}
```

ellie_ops: Browser console from repro run: `Blocked third-party cookie in user agent` and `Refused to display 'https://acs.acquirer.example' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'DENY'`. Looks like ACS is not iframe-friendly and our autopay tried an in-iframe flow. Also CSP on client prevents redirect landing inside our pay widget.

maria_billing: Also noticed gateway flagged the attempt with risk: {"score":0.86,"reasons":["vat_mismatch","billing_name_diff"]}. The invoice billing VAT (GB999888777) != gateway supplied tax_id (?) — merchant earlier updated billing name recently. Could be contributing to challenge.

raj_payments: Summary: (1) autopay attempted server-side charge that required SCA challenge, (2) our current autopay path attempted to surface challenge in an iframe (not supported by acquirer), (3) ACS expects a redirect or out-of-band completion which fails in autopay, (4) invoice has po_required so we don't normally send pay-now link automatically.

nina_support: Customer requests immediate manual recovery path — either attach PO to payment method and re-run, or send pay link for finance to complete SCA. Which is fastest?

raj_payments: Quick mitigation: 1) send a one-time pay link to the customer that runs full hosted checkout (redirect SCA flow) and does not attempt in-iframe autopay. 2) Update invoice metadata to include PO if customer provides it, then attempt a server charge but only if gateway returns can_handle_challenge_out_of_band=true. I'll create a quick runbook.

ellie_ops: For longer term: change autopay fallback to prefer redirect host flow when gateway next_action.type==redirect_to_url and we detect X-Frame-Options or SameSite issues. Add a telemetry flag for iframe-blocked and increment incident if repeated.

maria_billing: Customer sent PO-2041 in DM to support. Nina, can you confirm with customer that we will send hosted pay link (email) and that we will attach PO metadata once they confirm? Also ask them to verify VAT number/billing name with acquirer to reduce risk score.

nina_support: @maria_billing got PO-2041. I'll confirm and send hosted pay link. Also ping @raj_payments to run a manual retry once payment completes. priority=high :rotating_light:

raj_payments: I'll queue a manual retry and annotate the attempt with `source: manual_retry_via_hosted_link` and include `po_number: PO-2041`. If the gateway still flags vat_mismatch we'll escalate to acquirer support and request manual review.

repro-bot: note: added repro ticket PT-5482 with logs and iframe failure artifacts. Link: https://internal.redwood/pt/5482

nina_support: Thanks team. I'll update the customer thread and close this Slack thread once payment completes or we have acquirer confirmation.

ellie_ops: small reminder: capture the original user-agent and cookies from the repro run and attach to PT-5482 — acquirers sometimes ask for that.

maria_billing: tagging finance ops for audit: @maria_billing -> audit-required: true

raj_payments: action items set: (A) Send hosted pay link to Vendora (nina) (B) Manual retry with PO metadata (raj) (C) If decline persists -> open acquirer ticket (raj) (D) Add autopay fallback task (ellie).

nina_support: @here update: hosted pay link sent at 2025-08-14T15:10Z, awaiting completion.
